positive_points: Sample at 10km spacing along each author-digitized Pleistocene intraspecific genetic break line using cumulative arc length in each species's local AEQD projection; keep only points located inside the author's same-species surveyed/clipped polygon to guarantee common sampling support.
background_points: Deterministic 20km planar grid (local AEQD projection centered at source range representative point, zero grid anchor), keep only points strictly inside same author clipped/surveyed range and >50km from any digitized break line; exclude unavailable or unsurveyed range.
exclusion_reason: Author's published break-drawing location uncertainty was explored at 50km; excluding background within 50km avoids ambiguous negative labels. Selection locked before running case/background grid.
nonindependence: Line points and grid sites are autocorrelated; train/evaluate by completely heldout species, infer species-cluster, not point IID.
provenance: Original shapes were native EPSG:3857 breaks, mostly EPSG:4326 ranges; every species reprojected to geographic WGS84 then AEQD before geometry and distances.
sensitivity: 50km uniform random jitter of positive points within sampling polygon (fixed independent seed, not result-dependent); no alternative thresholds or post-response retuning.
climate_study: CHELSA-TraCE21k 21ka/0BP four bioclim variables; true author barrier controls should be obtained before history effect can be claimed.
source_rights: Do not distribute IUCN-derived clipped range polygons or point grids derived from licensed spatial boundaries.
